```{r}
library(tidycensus)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(fixest)
library(readr)
library(janitor)
library(units)
library(ggplot2)

```

```{r}
census_api_key(Sys.getenv("CENSUS_API_KEY"), install = FALSE)
```

Import data

```{r}
vars <- c(
  #commuting data
  total_commuters = "B08301_001",
  drove_alone = "B08301_003",
  public_transport = "B08301_010",
  light_rail = "B08301_012", #Subway or elevated rail
  heavy_rail = "B08301_013", #Long distance train or commuter rail
  #labor variables
  pop_16_total = "B23025_001", # total population for labor variables
  in_labor_force = "B23025_002",
  employed = "B23025_004",
  median_household_income = "B19013_001",
  ## control demographics 
  black = "B02001_003",
  white = "B02001_002",
  asian = "B02001_005"
)

years = 2011:2024

counties <- c("Denver", "Arapahoe", "Jefferson", "Adams", "Douglas")
```


```{r}

den_list <- map(years, ~
  get_acs(
    geography = "tract",
    variables = vars,
    state = "CO",
    county = counties,
    year = .x,
    geometry = TRUE,
    output = "wide"
  ) %>%
    mutate(year = .x)
)

denver <- bind_rows(den_list) %>%
  distinct(GEOID, year, .keep_all = TRUE)

## E is estimate, M is margin of error

```

```{r}
stations_sf <- stations_df %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(26954)  # Colorado Central projection (meters) for accurate distance
```

```{r}
## tract centroids

denver_centroids <- denver %>%
  st_transform(26954) %>%
  st_centroid()

```

Assign treatment years to lines

```{r}
# treatment period tags
stations_sf <- stations_sf %>%
  mutate(treat_period = case_when(
    lines == "W"                        ~ 2013,
    lines %in% c("A", "B", "R", "E/F/R") ~ 2016,
    lines %in% c("B/G", "W/G", "G", "N") ~ 2019,
    lines == "E/F/R"                    ~ 2019,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  ))
```

For each tract, find the nearest station and its distance

```{r}
nearest_idx <- st_nearest_feature(denver_centroids, stations_sf)
nearest_dist <- st_distance(denver_centroids, stations_sf[nearest_idx, ], by_element = TRUE)

denver_centroids <- denver_centroids %>%
  mutate(
    nearest_station  = stations_sf$name[nearest_idx],
    nearest_dist_m   = as.numeric(nearest_dist),
    station_period   = stations_sf$treat_period[nearest_idx],
    within_800m      = nearest_dist_m <= 800
  )
```

Create a treated group based on an 800m range
```{r}
denver <- denver %>%
  left_join(
    st_drop_geometry(denver_centroids) %>%
      select(GEOID, nearest_station, nearest_dist_m, station_period, within_800m) %>%
      distinct(GEOID, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = "GEOID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    treated = case_when(
      !within_800m                   ~ 0,
      year >= station_period         ~ 1,
      TRUE                           ~ 0
    ),
    post_W   = as.integer(within_800m & station_period == 2013 & year >= 2013),
    post_ABR = as.integer(within_800m & station_period == 2016 & year >= 2016),
    post_GN  = as.integer(within_800m & station_period == 2019 & year >= 2019)
  )
```


```{r}
denver_treated <- denver %>%
  filter(treated == 1)
```
